program: Certificate for Graduates of Non-EU/EEA Nursing Programmes

program: MQF Level 5 Certificate in Health Sciences - Nursing Studies (Bridging Course)
entry_requirements: Council for Nurses and Midwives needs IELTS 6.0 average or OET B speaking and C+ elsewhere to register. MQF 5 / 41 ECTS including a 330 hour placement / 8 months full time. Needs a nursing qualification at MQF 5 or comparable. IDEA publishes 5250 euro but says that price applies to students already resident in Malta when they apply so there is no published price for somebody applying from India

program: MQF Level 5 Diploma in Health Sciences - Nursing Studies
entry_requirements: Council for Nurses and Midwives needs IELTS 6.0 average or OET B speaking and C+ elsewhere to register. This is the course the Council links from its non-EU page although only the Certificate above carries Bridging Course in its title; confirm with IDEA and the Council which one they accept before anybody pays. MQF 5 / 60 ECTS / 12 months full time. Entry stated at MQF 4. Placement hours contradict on IDEA's own page at 510 and 100. IDEA publishes 6000 euro for students already resident in Malta when they apply

program: (MQF L6) Award in Nursing and Health Studies (Bridging Course)
entry_requirements: Council for Nurses and Midwives needs IELTS 6.0 average or OET B speaking and C+ elsewhere to register. MQF 6 / 30 ECTS / 9 months full time on campus with a 320 hour supervised placement. Needs a full nursing qualification at MQF 5 or 6. Fee of 6500 euro is the non-EU rate for the whole award plus a 300 euro registration fee; uniform and equipment are extra. ECI states plainly that finishing does not guarantee the Council will accept you

program: Undergraduate Certificate in Nursing (Bridging Course) TI5-04-18
